---
title: "Mann-Whitney Competing proportion"
params:
  lang: de
---


```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)



task <- "mannwhitney2"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

hook(n_a, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_b, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(u, U)

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_a <- sample(12:25, 1)
  n_b <- sample(15:30, 1)
  if (n_a == n_b)
    next
  pairs <- n_a * n_b
  u <- sample(2:(pairs - 2), 1)

  Q <- quote(search(mannwhitney2, mannwhitney2(u, n_a, n_b), .S, .R, .P, .E))

  S <- findall(Q, options = list(preproc = as.rolog), env = environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next
  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

Bei einem Mann-Whitney-Vergleich hat Gruppe A `r n_a` und Gruppe B
`r n_b` Teilnehmer:innen. Gruppe A gewinnt `r u` der paarweisen Vergleiche.

Berechne die competing proportion der Gruppe A.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
Die competing proportion der Gruppe A wird folgendermaßen berechnet: $\mathrm{CP}=$ `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
